id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

username.description: A unique username for the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the user account details were updated.

name.description: The name or title of the meeting. Only present for scheduled meetings.

hostId.description: The UID of the user who created the meeting.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the meeting was created.

scheduledAt.description: The scheduled start time for the meeting. Only present for scheduled meetings.

status.description: The current status of the meeting.

isLocked.description: Indicates if the meeting is locked. If true, new users are placed in the waiting room.

isRecording.description: Indicates if the meeting is currently being recorded.

geminiNotesEnabled.description: If true, the Gemini Notes feature is available in the meeting.

participantPermissions.description: Defines permissions for participants, controlled by the host.

allowShareScreen.description: If true, participants can share their screen.

allowSendReactions.description: If true, participants can send reactions like raising their hand.

allowUnmute.description: If true, participants can unmute their own microphone.

allowStartVideo.description: If true, participants can turn on their own video.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: Represents a participant in a meeting.

name.description: The display name of the participant.

joinedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the participant joined.

role.description: The role of the user in the meeting. 'waiting' means they are in the waiting room.

hasRaisedHand.description: Indicates if the participant has raised their hand.

isMuted.description: Indicates if the participant has been muted by the host.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single chat message within a meeting.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

senderName.description: The display name of the sender.

text.description: The content of the chat message.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

definition.description: User profile document storing public information. The document ID (`userId`) MUST correspond to the Firebase Authentication UID.
Stores information about a video meeting session.
A sub-collection representing participants in a meeting. The participantId should be the user's UID.
A sub-collection representing the chat history for a meeting.
